title: Spain Valencia Crop Fields
description: Official agricultural field boundaries for Spain's Valencian Community, sourced from the SIGPAC Geographic Information System for the 2024 campaign (data dated 2024-01-15), with additional vintages for 2022 and 2023. Contains 2,319,893 field enclosures with crop classification codes and administrative identifiers, converted to fiboa GeoParquet format from FEGA shapefiles.

## README.md
# Field boundaries for Spain Valencia

Provides 2319893 official field boundaries from Spain Valencia.
It has been converted to a fiboa GeoParquet file from data obtained from Spanish Agricultural Guarantee Fund (FEGA) of the Ministry of Agriculture, Fisheries and Food.

- **Source Data Provider:** [Spanish Agricultural Guarantee Fund (FEGA) of the Ministry of Agriculture, Fisheries and Food](https://www.fega.gob.es/es/PwfGcp/es/el_fega/index.jsp)
- **Converted by:** Ivor Bosloper
- **License:** CC-BY-4.0 (taken from http://www.icv.gva.es/condiciones-de-uso-de-la-geoinformacion-icv )
- **Projection:** EPSG:25830  /EPSG:3042

---

- [Download the data as fiboa GeoParquet](https://data.source.coop/fiboa/es-vc/es_vc.parquet)
- [STAC Browser](https://radiantearth.github.io/stac-browser/#/external/data.source.coop/fiboa/es-vc/stac/collection.json)
- [STAC Collection](https://data.source.coop/fiboa/es-vc/stac/collection.json)
- [PMTiles](https://data.source.coop/fiboa/es-vc/es_vc.pmtiles)

## Columns

| Property                | **Data Type** | Description |
|-------------------------|---------------|-------------|
| id                      | string        |             |
| admin_province_code     | string        |             |
| admin_municipality_code | string        |             |
| area                    | float         |             |
| crop:code               | string        |             |
| crop:name               | string        |             |
| crop:name_en            | string        |             |
| admin:country_code      | string        |             |
| crop:code_list          | string        |             |
| admin:subdivision_code  | string        |             |
| determination_datetime  | timestamp     |             |
